usedFor: Slack is where requests land and TeamGantt plans the work, so each channel message can run “Create Task”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Message Posted in Channel Instant” in Slack, then “Create Task” in TeamGantt
bestTemplate.why: A message in the chosen channel becomes a task or milestone in the selected project.

watchOut: “New Message Posted in Channel Instant” includes bot messages, so a bot post in that channel also creates a task.
